name: reiverr
description: Reiverr is a project that aims to create a single UI for interacting with TMDB, Jellyfin, Radarr and Sonarr, as well as be an alternative to Overseerr.

paths.name: Config Path
paths.description: Where the config file will be stored

variables.name: JWT Secret
variables.description: Used to sign JWT tokens for authentication. If not set, sessions will not persist between server restarts. Use a random string.

variables.name: Admin Username
variables.description: Default admin username. If not set, the first account created will be made an admin.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Default admin password. If not set, the first account created will be made an admin.
